title: Wall-backed bed and fixed TV working studies

options.title: North headboard wall · east lounge
options.description: REJECT: compact bedsides and weak entry composition for this brief. Two fixed TVs; the bed is backed by the existing north wall. Compact 360 mm bedsides beside the entrance; west bed access is tighter. Estimated maximum head turn across the sampled seats: bed 6°, sofa 12°. 1.90 m bed frame assumed; fixed TV cabinet separates the south-window desk.

options.title: South headboard wall · west lounge
options.description: UNRESOLVED: full-suite routines, daylight and occupied eye-level views required. A wider headboard setting with 500 mm bedsides and two fixed TVs. Bed TV needs a new return wall for the adjoining dressing / ensuite area. Estimated maximum head turn across the sampled seats: bed 5°, sofa 15°. The 1.8 m desk uses the south-window bay; entrance stays clear.
